title: Planted in Pretraining, Swayed by Finetuning: A Case Study on the Origins of Cognitive Biases in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model responses to paired control (neutral) and treatment (bias-inducing) prompts situated in realistic decision-making scenarios. Bias is quantified using a normalized score in the range [-1, 1] based on differences in option selection (e.g., using a 7-point Likert scale, 11-point percentage scale, or target option proportion) between the two conditions.
Observing systematic shifts in the model's judgments and decision-making preferences when group identity information or in-group/out-group markers are introduced in the treatment prompts.
